{"tool": "write_file", "args": {"path": "scripts/merge_duplicates.py", "step": "P1", "content": """"One-time ops script: merge duplicate households in data/registry.json. MODIFIES data/registry.json.

Run from the Lifeline root:  python scripts/merge_duplicates.py

Finds groups of active households that are really the same family (same head-of-household
name by Soundex and same birth year), keeps the record whose household ID is valid, and
marks every other record in the group as status="merged" with merged_into set. No record
is ever deleted.
"""

import sys
from pathlib import Path

sys.path.insert(0, str(Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent))

from core.ids import is_valid_household_id  # noqa: E402
from registry.dedup import find_duplicates  # noqa: E402
from registry.register import get_household, load_households, set_status  # noqa: E402


def main() -> None:
    households = load_households()
    groups = find_duplicates(households)
    if not groups:
        print("no duplicate families found")
        return
    for group in groups:
        kept_id = next(hid for hid in group if is_valid_household_id(hid))
        for dup_id in group:
            if dup_id != kept_id:
                set_status(dup_id, "merged", merged_into=kept_id)
        kept = get_household(kept_id)
        merged = [hid for hid in group if hid != kept_id]
        print(f"family {kept.head.name}: kept {kept_id} (valid ID), "
              f"merged {', '.join(merged)} into it")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
"}}
